tooltip.avaliproject.dressing.tooltip: Apply to wounds to reduce bleeding.
tooltip.avaliproject.painkillers.tooltip: Reduces current pain by a third.
tooltip.avaliproject.aerogel.shift_down: The aerogel is an ephemeral lattice of molecules with incredible structural properties, despite weighing next to nothing.
tooltip.avaliproject.piru_colony.tooltip: Small, barnacle-like colonies which grow long frond-like feeding filaments.
tooltip.avaliproject.nakati_ovoid.toolti: A biolumiscent ovoid. Eventually this will grow into a colony.
tooltip.avaliproject.spicy_jerky.tooltip: Chunks of seasoned jerky, popular with hunters and explorers.
tooltip.avaliproject.kiri_fruit.tooltip: The fruiting body of a subterranean slime mould. This one has already sporing though.
tooltip.avaliproject.kiri_cider.tooltip: Slightly fermented kiri juice including a bit the ground-up rind and a dash of nakati
tooltip.avaliproject.tucker.tooltip: Just like normal cookies, only spikier.
tooltip.avaliproject.woven_graphene.tool: Grapene that's been woven specially for use in avali crafting stations.
tooltip.avaliproject.woven_fabric.toolti: A small square of woven fabric
tooltip.avaliproject.protosteel_ingot.to: A complex nanite-infused alloy, used to create strong weapons and armour.
tooltip.avaliproject.nanite_injector.too: A small Nanite Injector, used in crafting recipes.
tooltip.avaliproject.nakati_bark.tooltip: The spicy bark of the nakati plant. Usually ground up before use.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_bottle.toolti: A bottle made in aerogel, able to contain and conserve it's content
tooltip.avaliproject.aeromer.tooltip: All the benefits of aerogel, but with structural integrity!
tooltip.avaliproject.titanium_ingot.tool: Result of the smelting of titanium ore.
tooltip.avaliproject.durasteel_ingot.too: Result of the smelting of durasteel ore.
tooltip.avaliproject.refined_aegisalt.to: Result of the smelting of aegisalt ore.
tooltip.avaliproject.piru_noodle.tooltip: Sweet noodles made from piru frond flour, a staple for young avali.
tooltip.avaliproject.piru_flour.tooltip: Piru frond, ground down into a versatile flour-like substance. Not exactly edible.
tooltip.avaliproject.kiri_curry.tooltip: Spicy meat noodles with a rich kiri sauce.
tooltip.avaliproject.groou.tooltip: Juicy and sweet, similar to jelly.
tooltip.avaliproject.avalon_taco.tooltip: Super-hot nakati-spiced taco; sometimes eaten on a dare by non-avali.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_muffin.toolti: It was covered with kiri jam and decorated with some dried fruit of Tucker
tooltip.avaliproject.kirikiri_pie.toolti: A sour oculemon-filled pie with a sweet meringue topping.
tooltip.avaliproject.piru_frond.tooltip: A long, fibrous frond from a piru barnacle.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_hoe.tooltip: An Avali version of the classic hoe.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_axe.tooltip: An Avali version of the classic axe.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_spear.tooltip: A mid ranged melee weapon using avali technology. Greater damage but slower swings.
tooltip.avaliproject.protogen_axe.toolti: An enhanced version of the classic axe.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_pickaxe.toolt: An Avali version of the classic pickaxe.
tooltip.avaliproject.avali_sword.tooltip: An Avali version of the classic sword.
tooltip.avaliproject.protogen_sword.tool: An enhanced version of the classic sword.
tooltip.avaliproject.piru_frond.tooltip: A long, fibrous frond from a piru barnacle.
limb.avaliproject.head: Head
screen.avaliproject.wardrobe.title: Wardrobe - %s
screen.avaliproject.wardrobe.folder.tool: Open your custom skins folder. Any .png placed in a species folder shows up here.
screen.avaliproject.avali_recruit_propos: An Avali wants to join your pack!
message.avaliproject.avali.recruited: The Avali has joined your pack!
message.avaliproject.expie.hug_cooldown: They're not ready for another hug just yet...
message.avaliproject.pack.not_leader: Only the pack leader can do that
message.avaliproject.pack.full: Your pack is full (6 members max)
message.avaliproject.pack.already_in_pac: That player is already in a pack
message.avaliproject.pack.rank.daily_cap: You've done all you can for the pack today
message.avaliproject.pack.rank.packmate_: A packmate under your care has fallen. The pack holds you responsible.
message.avaliproject.pack.loss: The pack mourns %s. Pack Loss deepens to %s.
message.avaliproject.pack.rank.killed_av: You killed an Avali. Word spreads fast among the packs.
message.avaliproject.pack.rank.killed_pa: You killed your own packmate. This betrayal will not be forgotten.
tooltip.avaliproject.coconut: Hold an axe in your other hand and use to crack it open, or plant it on sand or dirt to grow a palm
tooltip.avaliproject.manokit_trinket: Craft with bone jewelry and a gem to set a stone.
tooltip.avaliproject.trinket_gem.moonsto: Night vision while the moon is up.
origin.avaliproject.expie.name: Expie
origin.avaliproject.avali.name: Avali
origin.avaliproject.avali.description: Hollow-boned and light, falls take less of a toll.
origin.avaliproject.sergal.name: Sergal
origin.avaliproject.sergal.description: A fierce hunter that hits a little harder.
origin.avaliproject.protogen.name: Protogen
origin.avaliproject.protogen.description: Synthetic plating offers some extra protection.
origin.avaliproject.wickerbeast.name: Wickerbeast
origin.avaliproject.wickerbeast.descript: Dense, horned and hard to push around; a natural digger.
origin.avaliproject.manokit.name: Manokit
origin.avaliproject.manokit.description: At home in the water: breathes and swims with ease.
power.avaliproject.expie_nimble.name: Nimble
power.avaliproject.sergal_strength.name: Hunter's Strength
power.avaliproject.protogen_plating.name: Plating
power.avaliproject.wickerbeast_stride.de: Steps up half a block higher.
power.avaliproject.manokit_gills.name: Gills
power.avaliproject.manokit_swimmer.name: Swimmer
origin.avaliproject.manokit_beachdweller: A sun-loving Manokit of the shallows and sandy shores. Changes your appearance to the Beachdweller Manokit.
origin.avaliproject.manokit_tribal.name: Tribal
origin.avaliproject.manokit_tribal.descr: A Manokit raised among the reef tribes, upright and nimble. Changes your appearance to the Tribal Manokit.
origin.avaliproject.manokit_arcane.name: Arcane
origin.avaliproject.manokit_arcane.descr: A rare gem-studded Manokit touched by the deep sea's magic. Changes your appearance to the Arcane Manokit.
power.avaliproject.avali_glide.name: Feathered Descent
power.avaliproject.avali_glide.descripti: Sneak while airborne to slow your fall into a short, controlled glide.
power.avaliproject.avali_cold_hardy.name: Cold Hardy
power.avaliproject.avali_cold_hardy.desc: Freezing and powder snow damage is reduced by 40%.
power.avaliproject.avali_snow_stride.des: Powder snow does not slow you down.
power.avaliproject.avali_keen_hearing.de: Every few seconds, hostile creatures within 16 blocks briefly glow, even through walls.
power.avaliproject.avali_rest_regen.name: Pack Rest
power.avaliproject.avali_rest_regen.desc: Slowly regenerate health while out of combat. Does not reduce incoming damage.
power.avaliproject.avali_hydrophobia.des: Water and rain burn you like fire.
power.avaliproject.avali_water_bottle_bu: Drinking a water bottle scalds you.
power.avaliproject.avali_heat_weakness.d: Fire, lava and hot-ground damage taken is increased by 40%.
power.avaliproject.avali_carnivore.name: Carnivore
power.avaliproject.avali_pack_ping.name: Pack Ping
power.avaliproject.avali_pack_ping.descr: Active (30s cooldown): you and all players within 12 blocks gain Speed I for 8 seconds.
origin.avaliproject.avali.neoorigins_des: A small, cold-adapted pack scout. Keen ears, a light frame and a short glide, but water burns, heat hurts, and they are no fighter.
power.avaliproject.sergal_high_step.name: High Step
power.avaliproject.sergal_high_step.desc: Step up one extra block without jumping.
power.avaliproject.sergal_swift.name: Swift
Melee hits with swords, axes and tridents deal 25% more damage. Bows are unchanged.
power.avaliproject.sergal_marked_prey.de: Creatures you hit glow for 10 seconds.
power.avaliproject.sergal_heavy_frame.de: Chestplates and leggings give you 30% less armor.
power.avaliproject.sergal_dig_window.des: Tracks how recently you broke a block.
power.avaliproject.sergal_dig_strain.des: Tracks how long you have been mining without a break.
power.avaliproject.sergal_dig_tracker.de: Breaking blocks keeps your dig strain building.
power.avaliproject.sergal_dig_fatigue.de: After about 30 seconds of continuous mining you get Mining Fatigue. Moving or fighting resets it.
power.avaliproject.sergal_dig_focus_brea: Landing a hit resets your dig strain.
power.avaliproject.sergal_poor_archer.de: Projectiles you shoot deal 20% less damage.
power.avaliproject.sergal_driving_leap.d: Active (8s cooldown): lunge about 6 blocks forward. Anything at the landing spot takes 5 damage and is knocked back. A miss still takes the fall.
origin.avaliproject.sergal.neoorigins_de: A fast northern skirmisher built for blades and axes. Hits hard up close, but heavy armor fits poorly and long mining sessions wear them down.
power.avaliproject.protogen_optics.name: Low-Light Optics
power.avaliproject.protogen_optics.descr: You see slightly better in the dark. Disabled while wet.
power.avaliproject.protogen_chassis.name: Armored Chassis
power.avaliproject.protogen_chassis.desc: +4 armor from your built-in chest plate. Replaced by, not stacked with, a worn chestplate.
power.avaliproject.protogen_filters.name: Toxin Filters
power.avaliproject.protogen_filters.desc: Poison and wither damage taken is reduced by 20%.
power.avaliproject.protogen_conductive.d: Lightning and magic damage taken is increased by 50%.
power.avaliproject.protogen_brace_mode.d: Stores which leg mode is engaged.
power.avaliproject.protogen_modular_legs: Active: swap between Stride and Brace leg modes. Only one mode is engaged at a time.
power.avaliproject.protogen_stride.name: Stride Mode
power.avaliproject.protogen_stride.descr: While in Stride: +20% movement speed, -10% mining speed.
power.avaliproject.protogen_brace.name: Brace Mode
power.avaliproject.protogen_brace.descri: While in Brace: +15% mining speed, -10% movement speed.
power.avaliproject.protogen_short_circui: While wet you suffer Slowness and Mining Fatigue, and your optics shut off.
power.avaliproject.protogen_sensor_crown: Your head is a sensor array. You cannot wear helmets.
power.avaliproject.protogen_scan.name: Scan
power.avaliproject.protogen_scan.descrip: Active (20s cooldown, costs hunger): ores and creatures within 8 blocks glow for 6 seconds.
origin.avaliproject.protogen.neoorigins_: A synthetic surveyor with a sensor crown, armored chassis and swappable leg modes. Water shorts their systems, and lightning and magic hit hard.
power.avaliproject.expie_springy.name: Springy
power.avaliproject.expie_wall_slide.name: Wall Slide
power.avaliproject.expie_wall_slide.desc: Sneak against a wall while falling to slow into a slide. You cannot climb.
power.avaliproject.expie_warm_blood.name: Warm Blood
power.avaliproject.expie_warm_blood.desc: Regeneration I while above half health. Paused for 5 seconds after taking damage.
While sneaking you see a little better in the dark.
power.avaliproject.expie_fragile.name: Fragile
power.avaliproject.expie_fragile.descrip: You have 8 hearts of maximum health.
power.avaliproject.expie_sinker.name: Dense Fur
power.avaliproject.expie_panic.name: Panic
power.avaliproject.expie_panic.descripti: Below 4 hearts you suffer short pulses of Weakness unless you are sprinting away.
power.avaliproject.expie_carnivore.name: Carnivore
power.avaliproject.expie_breakpoint.name: Breakpoint
power.avaliproject.expie_breakpoint.desc: Active (60s cooldown, only below half health): Speed II and Jump Boost II for 6 seconds, then Hunger III and Mining Fatigue for 10 seconds.
origin.avaliproject.expie.neoorigins_des: A small, springy climber that slides down walls and bolts when cornered. Fragile, a poor swimmer, and strictly carnivorous.
power.avaliproject.wickerbeast_bite.name: Bite
power.avaliproject.wickerbeast_bite.desc: Unarmed hits bite for 5 damage and apply Slowness I for 2 seconds.
power.avaliproject.wickerbeast_sure_foot: Falls of less than 6 blocks deal half damage.
Fire damage taken is increased by 30%.
power.avaliproject.wickerbeast_axe_rhyth: You attack 10% slower with anything that is not an axe.
power.avaliproject.wickerbeast_tail_whip: Active (12s cooldown): sweep your tail around you for 4 damage, strong knockback and Slowness II for 1 second.
origin.avaliproject.wickerbeast.neoorigi: A big drake-like land hunter. Sturdy, fast, and quick to bite, with a sweeping tail, but heavy in water and dry-skinned near fire.
power.avaliproject.manokit_bite.name: Nip
power.avaliproject.manokit_ears.name: Twitching Ears
power.avaliproject.manokit_ears.descript: Hostile creatures within 8 blocks briefly glow every few seconds.
Falls of less than 5 blocks deal 25% less damage.
power.avaliproject.manokit_diet.name: Hunter's Diet
power.avaliproject.manokit_diet.descript: Meat and fish restore full hunger. Bread and vegetables restore only half.
power.avaliproject.manokit_blessing.name: Blessing
power.avaliproject.manokit_blessing.desc: A reserve of the sea's blessing that your subspecies spends on its abilities. Slowly refills out of combat.
origin.avaliproject.manokit.neoorigins_d: A compact, sharp-eared hunter blessed by the sea. Choose a subspecies to shape the rest of your kit.
power.avaliproject.dweller_gills.name: Gills
power.avaliproject.dweller_tidal_swimmer: You swim 60% faster while your blessing holds.
power.avaliproject.dweller_wet_hands.des: No underwater mining penalty, and you deal 20% more damage while wet.
power.avaliproject.dweller_deep_sight.de: Night vision while underwater or at night.
power.avaliproject.dweller_land_clumsy.d: You move 25% slower out of water.
power.avaliproject.dweller_sun_glare.des: Clear daylight out of water dims your sight to about 8 blocks until you get back in the water or out of the sun.
power.avaliproject.dweller_tide_mend.des: Active (costs 33 blessing): heal yourself and players within 3 blocks by 4 health while wet, or 2 health on land.
power.avaliproject.dweller_undertow.name: Undertow
power.avaliproject.dweller_undertow.desc: Active (25s cooldown): in water, dash forward and drag a nearby creature toward you. On land, only a weak hop.
power.avaliproject.dweller_drained.name: Drained
power.avaliproject.dweller_drained.descr: Set while your blessing has run dry.
power.avaliproject.dweller_ebb.name: Ebb Tide
power.avaliproject.dweller_ebb.descripti: When your blessing runs empty you sink and lose your swim bonus until it recovers to 30.
origin.avaliproject.manokit_beachdweller: A Manokit of the shallows. Breathes and fights well in water but is clumsy and sun-blinded on land. Changes your appearance to the Beachdweller Manokit.
power.avaliproject.tribal_canopy_climber: You can climb logs, leaves and vines. Does not work in water.
power.avaliproject.tribal_grove_mend.des: Standing on grass, moss or leaves slowly heals you, spending blessing.
power.avaliproject.tribal_cave_dread.des: Unlit caves dim your sight to about 8 blocks until you reach light or open sky.
Set while you are running in Holoholo form.
power.avaliproject.tribal_holoholo.name: Holoholo
power.avaliproject.tribal_holoholo.descr: Active: drop onto all fours. You shrink, run much faster and drain blessing, but cannot mine or use weapons. An empty blessing forces you upright with Hunger.
In Holoholo form: about 60% size, +50% speed, no mining, no weapon damage.
origin.avaliproject.manokit_tribal.neoor: A Manokit of the forest edge. Quick on land, climbs trees and vines, and can drop into the fast Holoholo run, but fears dark caves and swims poorly. Changes your appearance to the Tribal Manokit.
power.avaliproject.arcane_resonance.name: Resonance
power.avaliproject.arcane_resonance.desc: Hostile creatures within 10 blocks glow for longer than your base ears allow, even through walls.
power.avaliproject.arcane_sun_ache.name: Sun Ache
power.avaliproject.arcane_sun_ache.descr: Daylight on the surface dims your sight to about 8 blocks until you are out of the sun.
power.avaliproject.arcane_crystal_charge: Active (costs 12 blessing): you and players within 4 blocks gain Speed for 8 seconds, or Strength if you are sneaking. Casting while your blessing is at or below half also gives you Mining Fatigue and a crystal spark.
Your crystals chime as you walk, making your footsteps slightly louder.
origin.avaliproject.manokit_arcane.neoor: A crystal-studded Manokit of the deep caves. Mines fast underground and channels blessing into allies, but is slow, sun-shy and loud. Changes your appearance to the Arcane Manokit.
effect.avaliproject.pack_loss.incurable: The pack does not forget. Nothing cures this.
